workarounds.symptom: [Bug] Mooncake async migration can hang forever and make Decode unavailable
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(disagg): await Mooncake async migration executor future (#4971). Target files: lmdeploy/pytorch/disagg/backend/mooncake.py, tests/pytorch/disagg/test_mooncake_async_migration.py. - Fixes [#4971](https://github.com/InternLM/lmdeploy/issues/4971): with `LMDEPLOY_USE_ASYNC_MIGRATION`, Decode hung forever after Prefill finished. - Root cause: `MooncakeMigrationBackend.p2p_migrate` created an unused `asyncio.Future` and awaited it after `run_in_executor`, so the coroutine never completed even though `_migrate` already finis... (Ref: https://github.com/InternLM/lmdeploy/pull/5021)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug] 0.16.0和0.17.0版本lmdeploy加载InternVL3-78B模型W4A16量化版时内存要比0.15.0以及之前的版本要多150GB内存
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(internvit): allocate pinned input buffers on demand. Target files: src/turbomind/models/internvit/internvit.cc. Fix excessive host memory usage when loading InternVL models. InternViT previously preallocated pinned input buffers using max_forward_token_num as the image batch capacity, causing unnecessarily large allocations at startup. Allocate buffers when an image batch is first processed, sized to the actual number of image tiles. Reuse existing buffers and grow them only when a larger batch arrives. . (Ref: https://github.com/InternLM/lmdeploy/pull/4982)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug] turbomind can not support fp8 in SM75
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(turbomind): restore FP8 weight-only fallback on pre-sm90 GPUs. Applied modifications to lmdeploy/turbomind/builders/ffn.py, src/turbomind/kernels/attention/kernel/decoding_sm75_256.cu, src/turbomind/kernels/gemm/cast.cu. (Ref: https://github.com/InternLM/lmdeploy/pull/4871)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug] int4 KV cache: the quantization range is stretched to include 0 when the packed head width is not a power of two
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Fix int4 KV cache quantization range when the packed head width is not a power of two. Target files: lmdeploy/pytorch/kernels/cuda/fill_kv_cache.py, tests/pytorch/kernel/test_fill_kv_cache.py. - `_fill_page_quant_int4`: add `d_off = d_off % head_dim` so the lanes past the head wrap onto real channels, and load `state0`/`state1` with `kv_mask[:, None]` instead of `mask_kc` so those lanes carry data rather than `0.0`. This is exactly the shape `_fill_page_quant_int8` has. The store keeps `mask_kc`, so nothing extra is writte... (Ref: https://github.com/InternLM/lmdeploy/pull/4850)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug] Unauthenticated pickle deserialization via ZMQ in disaggregated serving → RCE
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(disagg): use JSON instead of pickle for P2P ZMQ requests (#4804). Target files: lmdeploy/pytorch/disagg/conn/engine_conn.py. The disaggregated-serving P2P connector deserializes peer-supplied bytes with `pickle`: (Ref: https://github.com/InternLM/lmdeploy/pull/4812)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug] Legacy /v1/completions list-prompt path ignores request.session_id, crashes under concurrency
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(serve): auto-generate batch completion sessions to avoid id collision (#4773). Target files: lmdeploy/serve/openai/api_server.py. The legacy `/v1/completions` endpoint assigns one session per prompt. When `request.prompt` is a list, `completions_v1` created sessions with hardcoded user ids `1, 2, 3...`: (Ref: https://github.com/InternLM/lmdeploy/pull/4774)
